'''Heavy Stormtroopers''' were a variant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] which carried [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 repeating blasters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Heavy Stormtroopers appear in the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' line. The art on the figurine's reference card is of an [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock trooper]] as depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II|Battlefront II]].''
